name: app-modernization
description: Plan and execute app rewrites with visual baselines, executable scenarios and independent validation.

interface.shortDescription: Rewrite apps with proven behavior and visual baselines.
interface.longDescription: Two focused skills for app modernization and behavior baselines. Capture user journeys, screenshots, diagrams, technical execution and dependencies; run comparison scenarios before rewriting and reuse specialist skills for implementation and final independent validation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Modernize this application while preserving its proven behavior and measuring intended improvements.
